kinds.action: choose what an offering will aim for next and what it will refuse
kinds.name: Product strategy canvas
kinds.timing: before committing time and money to the next planning period

kinds.action: check whether a business can deliver an offering its customers value and earn more than providing it costs
kinds.actor: whoever starts, runs or funds the business
kinds.name: Business model canvas
kinds.timing: before committing money or time to the business, and again whenever its customers, delivery or income change

kinds.action: choose which assumption in a new venture's business model to test next
kinds.name: Lean canvas
kinds.timing: before the venture has shown that customers will pay for it

kinds.action: decide what a new venture will aim for and how it will make money
kinds.actor: whoever is founding the venture, with any backers
kinds.name: Startup canvas

kinds.action: compare our strengths and weaknesses with the opportunities and threats outside us
kinds.name: Swot analysis

kinds.action: check which political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental conditions affect the work
kinds.name: Pestle analysis
kinds.timing: before setting the plan, and again when laws, markets or technology change

kinds.action: find where the offering can differ from the other options people have, including doing nothing
kinds.actor: whoever decides what to offer or how to present it
kinds.name: Competitor analysis
kinds.timing: whenever another option appears or changes

kinds.action: decide which kind of person, in which circumstance, to design the solution for
kinds.actor: whoever designs the solution or studies the people it is for
kinds.name: Persona profile

kinds.action: decide whether to pursue a problem at all
kinds.actor: whoever would fund or approve the work
kinds.name: Opportunity assessment
kinds.timing: before committing people or money to the work

kinds.action: decide which risks to reduce, accept or watch, and who handles each
kinds.actor: the person accountable for the work
kinds.name: Risk assessment
kinds.timing: before the work starts, and while it runs

kinds.action: agree to or object to one proposed approach
kinds.name: Design doc

kinds.action: apply the brand's look and wording correctly on your own
kinds.actor: anyone writing or designing for the brand
kinds.name: Brand identity guide
kinds.timing: whenever making new material for the brand

kinds.action: check, step by step, that one person can reach one goal through the solution
kinds.name: Scenario walkthrough

kinds.action: decide which numbers to improve next and which to keep where they are
kinds.actor: whoever runs the offering day to day
kinds.name: Success metrics
kinds.timing: at each regular review of the offering

kinds.action: find which parts of the system a change will affect
kinds.name: Architecture overview

kinds.action: find what the system is responsible for and which outside people and systems it works with
kinds.name: System context diagram
kinds.timing: when first working with the system

kinds.action: choose one of several options by a set date
kinds.actor: the person accountable for the choice
kinds.name: Decision brief
kinds.timing: before anyone commits to an option

kinds.action: check whether a past decision still applies, and record a replacement when it no longer does
kinds.name: Decision record

kinds.action: commit to a test's prediction and its measures in advance
kinds.name: Experiment plan
kinds.timing: before collecting any data for the test

universe_spec.covers: The reasoning around deliberate work — what makes it worth doing, what it should be, and whether it held up. The work may produce something made or put in place, a service rendered, or something learned; for a recipient — including your own later self — who simply receives it, free to take it or leave it, or paying for it.
universe_spec.for: Whoever is accountable for that judgement or has to account for it later — one person on one machine, a group, or an organisation.
universe_spec.label: Product development
